verdict.rationale: Exemption certificate management is a fair question for a sales-tax product, but the evidence pack never documents collecting, validating, storing or expiry-tracking exemption or resale certificates, or applying them at calculation time. The nearby evidence covers different things: zero-tax results with a taxability_reason field, and a one-time VIES check of VAT numbers. Neither is certificate management, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time
